Kerala
Viswakarma Pension Scheme
Carpenters Goldsmiths Iron Worker Moosari Pension Stone Worker
Viswakarma Community Wood Worker
The Scheme “Viswakarma Pension” was launched by the ward Classes
Development Department, Government of Kerala to give a pension to traditional
workers of Viswakarma Communities (Carpenters (wood, iron, stone), Goldsmiths,
Moosari) who have completed 60 years of age in the Kerala State.

No new available
English
10/2/26, 3:31 PM Viswakarma Pension Scheme
1/6
Eligibility
Application Process
Offline Online
Feed 1. The monthly pension amount of ₹1100/- will be given to the persons belonging
to the traditional Viswakarma Communities.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Kerala State.
2. The applicant should belong to the traditional Viswakarma Community of Kerala
State.
3. The age of the applicant should be more than 60 years.
4. The annual family income of the applicant should be ₹1,00,000/-.
Step 01: The applicant should visit the Official Website of the ward Classes
Development Department, Government of Kerala, and download the
application form.
Step 02: Fill out the application form completely and send it along with all the
relevant documents to the following addresses:
Director, ward Classes Development Department
Ayyankali Bhavan, 4th Floor, Kanakanagar
